title: Project layer (private): one repository and Linear project
description: Stored as projects/<name>.json. The Linear project is referenced by exact name and resolved to an ID at dry-run/preflight.

interface_version.description: The runner-project interface this profile was written for (registry/interface.json); validate-config refuses an older one with the migration steps.

contract_file.description: Shared contract every issue follows; the intake references it by path and SHA-256 instead of inlining it.

intake_mode.description: compact (default): issue-specific intake with file references; full: the schema-1 packet with every context file inlined.

allow_empty.description: true: exit code 5 (pytest: no tests collected or selected) is recorded as the outcome 'empty' and counts as passing. Part of the check definition and its reuse identity.

timeout_seconds.description: How long this check may run; default registry phases.check_timeout_seconds, at most phases.max_check_timeout_seconds. Part of the check definition and its reuse identity.

last_issue.description: Extended checks only. 'always' (default): the check runs at the batch's last issue whatever changed. 'when_changed': at the last issue it runs only if a file changed since the batch's base revision matches its inputs; otherwise it is recorded as skipped.

integrity.description: Post-delivery integrity step (no model). manifest is relative to the issue's delivery directory; file_hashes values and true_fields files are relative to the manifest's directory.
